dialogue.origin: こんにちわ、相談員です。本日は、相談にお越しくださりありがとございます。はじめに、年齢、性別、ご相談内容を聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。40代　女性　夫の実家との付き合い方に悩んでいます
dialogue.content: Hello. I’m a woman in my 40s, and I’m struggling with how to handle my relationship with my husband’s family.

dialogue.origin: お聞かせ頂きありがとうございます。夫さんのご実家との関係のお悩みですね。詳しくお聞かせ頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. So you're having difficulties with your relationship with your husband's family. Could you please tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: はい。関係が悪く、しばらく疎遠になっています。家族で私だけ帰省していませんし、電話もでないようにしています。このままでいいのか、許されるのか、という気持ちです。
dialogue.content: Yes. Our relationship is poor, and we've been estranged for a while. I’m the only one in the family who doesn’t go back to visit, and I avoid answering their calls. I’m torn about whether it’s okay to keep things this way and whether it’s acceptable.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご実家のかたと、距離をおかれているにですね。それは、スッキリしない感じですね。関係が悪くなった原因は、何かありますか？
dialogue.content: So you're keeping your distance from your husband's family. That must feel unresolved. Is there a specific reason why the relationship deteriorated?

dialogue.origin: 結婚当初から価値観の違いに違和感はあったのですが、ある年の帰省で、傷つくことを言われ、私の中で関係を切りたいとなりました。
dialogue.content: I had felt a sense of unease about our differences in values since we first got married, but during a visit one year, they said something hurtful, and I decided I wanted to cut ties.

dialogue.origin: 帰省中と言う事で、緊張されていたとことに、傷付く事を言われたら関係を切りたくなるのは、当然ですね。傷付くことというエピソードを差し支えなければ教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: It's completely understandable that you'd want to cut ties after being told something hurtful, especially when you were likely already tense during the visit. If you don't mind, could you tell me about the hurtful incident?

dialogue.origin: はい。帰省中はだいたい夫のことを褒めたり労ったり近所に自慢したりするので、私はとても居心地が悪く我慢を重ねていました。会話の中にも無神経な言葉ばかりでしたが、環境や年齢の違いとなんとか割り切るようにしていました。ですが、
dialogue.content: Yes. During visits, they usually praise my husband, fuss over him, and brag about him to the neighbors, so I felt very out of place and kept enduring it. Their conversations were full of insensitive remarks, but I tried to overlook them, attributing it to differences in background and age. However—

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ある年、皆で食事を囲んでいる最中に、用意してもらったこともあり美味しいです、ありがとうございます。と言って場の空気を和ませたつもりでしたが、私が夫にそのような食事を与えていない、と言われ子供達に向かって、お父さんだけかわいそうだねーと悪口のような。それで我慢の限界となりました。
dialogue.content: One year, while we were all eating together, I tried to lighten the mood by saying, "This is delicious, thank you for preparing it." But they said that I don’t serve my husband meals like that, and, turning to the children, they said something like, "Your poor father," as if they were bad-mouthing me. That was the last straw for me.

dialogue.origin: それは、とても傷つく言葉ですね。悲しい思いをされましね。しかもお子おさんに向かって言うなんて、これ以上我慢できなくなる気持ちは当然です！夫さんの事を過剰に誉めている話や、自分に直接関係ない話を聞かされたり頑張って来られたのに…
dialogue.content: Those are very hurtful words. You must have felt so sad. And to say that in front of your children... it's completely natural that you couldn't tolerate it anymore! Especially after you had been trying so hard, listening to them excessively praise your husband and talk about things that didn't directly concern you...

dialogue.origin: その時の夫さんの反応は、どうでしたか？
dialogue.content: How did your husband react at that time?

dialogue.origin: 私は何も言わず、黙って荷物をまとめ、新幹線でそのまま帰宅しました。子供達は残そうかと思いましたが、ママと一緒に帰りたいと、夫だけ残して。夫はオロオロするだけでした。謝罪もなく、それきりです。
dialogue.content: I didn’t say anything; I quietly packed my things and took the bullet train straight home. I thought about leaving the children there, but they wanted to go home with me, so only my husband stayed. He just flustered around. There was no apology, and that was the end of it.

dialogue.origin: 夫は、無神経な親だから、とだけ言ってました
dialogue.content: My husband just said, "My parents are insensitive."

dialogue.origin: そこで、不満を口にださず頑張られたのですね。夫さんには謝罪して欲しいところですね。
dialogue.content: So you persevered without voicing your dissatisfaction then. You would have wanted an apology from your husband.

dialogue.origin: 無神経な人だから…以外には、何も言われなかったのですか？
dialogue.content: Besides saying they're insensitive, did he say anything else?

dialogue.origin: 口には出さなかったけど、帰省を取りやめという行動で示しました夫はもちろん、親にも謝罪してほしかったです
dialogue.content: I didn't say it out loud, but I showed it by stopping the visits. I wanted apologies from both my husband and his parents.

dialogue.origin: 夫は、私に、我慢してほしかったようなことを言ってました
dialogue.content: My husband said something to the effect that he wanted me to just put up with it.

dialogue.origin: 我慢は、沢山されているようにお見受けされますが…あなたが以前から我慢してきている事に気付いていなかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It seems to me you’ve been enduring quite a lot… Do you think he hadn’t realized how much you had been putting up with all along?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。親の言動に傷つく私が悪い、みたいに捉えていたと思います。我慢、というか、こんなことで傷つく？みたいな。
dialogue.content: That's right. I think he saw it as my fault for getting hurt by his parents' words and actions. It wasn't so much about endurance, but more like, "Why would you get hurt by something like that?"

dialogue.origin: 価値観の違いですね。
dialogue.content: It's a difference in values.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…夫さんは、あなたが頑張って耐えていた事に気付いていないし、むしろ傷付く方が悪いと思っていられるのですね…その言葉や、価値観にとても傷付きますよね。
dialogue.content: I see... So your husband isn't aware of how much you've been trying to endure, and he even thinks it's your fault for getting hurt. Those words and that perspective must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: はい。親子揃って…という感じです。
dialogue.content: Yes. It feels like he and his parents are both the same.

dialogue.origin: ただ、謝罪があればこんな関係にはなっていないと思うんです
dialogue.content: But I think if there had been an apology, things wouldn’t have ended up like this.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんも夫さんのご両親も…ということですね。それはしんどいですね。そうですね。謝罪する気持ちがあるという事で大分気の持ちようが変わってきますよね。
dialogue.content: Both your husband and his parents... that must be tough. I agree. Just knowing they were willing to apologize would make a big difference in how you feel.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんにそのことを伝えた事はありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever told your husband that?

dialogue.origin: はい。何度も伝えましたが、わかってもらえないし、実家に伝えても理解されない、と言われました
dialogue.content: Yes. I’ve told him many times, but he says he doesn't understand, and that even if he tells his family, they won’t understand either.

dialogue.origin: なので、疎遠になったままです
dialogue.content: So, we've remained estranged.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…伝える努力をされているのに態度が変わらない…それだと距離を置きたくなりますね。
dialogue.content: I see... So even though you've made an effort to communicate, their attitude hasn't changed. That would certainly make you want to keep your distance.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、最初にこれで良いのか…と悩まれていましたよね。改善したいというお気持ちはあるということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: But at the beginning, you mentioned you were wondering if this was okay... Does that mean you have a desire to improve the situation?

dialogue.origin: 改善したい気持ちと、このままが許されるならそれでもいいかな、と逃げるような気持ちの両方があります
dialogue.content: I have both a desire to improve things and a feeling of wanting to escape, thinking that if it's acceptable to stay like this, then that's fine too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。価値観が違うから…と切り捨てるのではなく改善したいというお気持ちをもたれているだけでも、素晴らしいと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. I think it's wonderful that you have the desire to improve the situation, rather than just dismissing it as a difference in values.

dialogue.origin: 子供達が、私抜きで帰省するのに複雑な気持ちを抱えているのがかわいそうで。改善したいのはそのためだけです。
dialogue.content: I feel sorry for my children, who have mixed feelings about visiting their grandparents without me. That's the only reason I want to improve things.

dialogue.origin: 親のためでも夫のためでもありません。
dialogue.content: It's not for my in-laws or for my husband.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの気持ちを思ってのことなのですね。お子さんは、やはりあなたも一緒に帰省して欲しいという感じですか？
dialogue.content: So it's for your children's sake. Do they seem to want you to join them on the visits?

dialogue.origin: はっきりとは言いませんが、そのようです。毎回、ママも行く？と聞かれますので。
dialogue.content: They don’t say it outright, but it seems so. Every time, they ask, "Mom, are you coming too?"

dialogue.origin: 遠いので、不安もあるようです
dialogue.content: It's a long way, so I think they also feel a bit anxious.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…お子さんは、お母さんと一緒が良いんですね。それは、悩みますね。
dialogue.content: I see... Your children want to be with their mom. That must be a dilemma.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご実家に帰省されるのをやめてからどれくらい経ちますか？
dialogue.content: How long has it been since you stopped visiting your husband's family?

dialogue.origin: もう5年くらいです
dialogue.content: It's been about five years now.

dialogue.origin: 5年なんですね。それは、このままでいってしまいたい…というお気持ちになりますね。
dialogue.content: Five years. I can understand why you'd feel like you want to just let things continue as they are.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 形だけみれば、不義理というか無礼な感じに、多少の負い目もあります
dialogue.content: On the surface, it looks like I'm being ungrateful or rude, and I do feel a little guilty about that.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…そういう気持ちをお持ちなんですね。旦那さんに今思っている気持ちをお伝えした事はありますか？
dialogue.content: I see... so you have those feelings as well. Have you shared your current thoughts with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 伝えたのは、行かない理由だけです
dialogue.content: I’ve only told him my reasons for not going.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。実は不義理にするのも…というお気持ちをお話しをされたら、夫さんはどんな反応をしそうですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. If you were to share that you actually feel some guilt about seeming discourteous, how do you think your husband would react?

dialogue.origin: 行かなくていい、と言うだけだと思いますまた関わると面倒なことになる、と考えると思います
dialogue.content: I think he would just say, "You don't have to go." I believe he'd think that getting involved again would just cause more trouble.

dialogue.origin: そう思われると思うと気持ちが萎んでしまいますよね。でも、まだ夫さんがそういうかは、確定ではないですよね。
dialogue.content: It's discouraging to think he would react that way. But it's not certain that he would, is it?

dialogue.origin: そうですが、長年の関係で、ほぼ間違いないです
dialogue.content: That's true, but given our long relationship, I'm almost certain of it.

dialogue.origin: まよっていられるなら一度夫さんに思い切ってお気持ちを話してみるのはでしょう。反応は、イマイチであれば、迷う気持ちが少し減る気がするのですが？
dialogue.content: If you're feeling uncertain, how about taking a chance and telling your husband how you feel? If his reaction is poor, it might help reduce some of your indecision.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 迷うとは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by indecision?

dialogue.origin: 分かりづらくてすみません。帰省するかどうかと迷うお気持ちです。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry if that was unclear. I meant your indecision about whether or not to visit his family.

dialogue.origin: 帰省するかしないかを、夫の反応をみて決断することはできません
dialogue.content: I can't decide whether or not to visit based on my husband's reaction.

dialogue.origin: 提案していただいたのにすみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, even though you suggested it.

dialogue.origin: 私の方こそ押し付けた意見を言ってしまってすみません。
dialogue.content: No, I'm the one who should apologize for pushing my opinion on you.

dialogue.origin: そもそも、謝罪がないまま帰省することはあり得ないです
dialogue.content: In the first place, visiting them without an apology is out of the question.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。謝罪する気持ち持ってもらえないとあなたの気持ちもスッキリしませんよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. Without them showing a willingness to apologize, your feelings won't be resolved.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんご両親に謝罪する意思をしめしていただけて、あなたがスッキリした気持ちで帰省出来る日がくるように願っています。
dialogue.content: I hope the day comes when your husband and his parents show a willingness to apologize, allowing you to visit with a clear mind.

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたので、ここで終了とさせて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Our time is up, so we will end the session here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 本日は、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: (クライエント役をして頂きありがとうございました。時間が伸びてしまってすみません)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for playing the role of the client. I'm sorry we went over time.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: It was a learning experience for me as well. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: このまま終了ボタンで大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's okay to press the end button now.

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそ大変勉強になりました。終了ボタン押させて頂きます。)
dialogue.content: (It was a great learning experience for me, too. I will press the end button.)

topic.sub: 夫の実家とのコミュニケーション問題
